kamloops.title: Bald Range wildfire near Summerland grows to more than 17,800 hectares
kamloops.description: On Tuesday, officials are expecting a high potential for lightning-caused wildfire starts, particularly in the central Interior and the Okanagan.

kamloops.title: Mexican reinforcements arriving for wildfire fight in Summerland, B.C.
kamloops.description: Reinforcements are arriving in the battle against a deadly wildfire on the shores of Okanagan Lake in the southern B.C. Interior that has forced 20,000 people to evacuate.

kamloops.title: Conservation officers continue search for bear after Maple Ridge girl attacked
kamloops.description: Three-year-old Anaiyah Lekei is now recovering after surgery. The bear clawed and bit her several times on the head, neck and back.

kamloops.title: Animal sanctuary among evacuees of Summerland wildfire
kamloops.description: Faith Affleck runs Stars Piggly Wigglys Sanctuary in Summerland and is currently staying in Okanagan Falls with two of her rescues.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire: Planning for re-entry already underway, but now is not the time
kamloops.description: This briefing comes as thousands of people remain out of their homes due to the Bald Range wildfire, which sparked on Friday afternoon.
